findings: PMK 81/2024 Article 94(2), including item g for Article 26 income tax, specifies the fifteenth day of the following month after the tax period ends.

Article 100 permits payment on the next working day when the due date is a specified holiday, including Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, election holidays and nationally designated collective leave.
The original regulation states commencement on 1 January 2025. Historical tax periods require separate applicability checks.
DGT Coretax guidance updated 17 September 2025 corroborates the general fifteenth-day payment and twentieth-day reporting deadlines, while explicitly warning of exceptions.
Text searches of PMK 1/2026 found no exact Article 94 or Article 100 references; this is not sufficient to establish the complete amendment chain.
remaining: Check the complete amendment chain, including PMK 54/2025 and earlier amendments, and relevant transition provisions.
Register and hash authoritative originals and create precise clause citations before changing the parameter.
Represent the deadline as a calendar day in the following month, rather than an elapsed-day duration; verify all parameter consumers.
Preserve historical applicability and test month/year rollover and holiday handling without inventing an unverified holiday calendar.
